Trapped in a grim pact with a deceptive mascot, a young girl discovers that granting her deepest wishes requires fighting a relentless war against corrupted souls. As her closest friends begin to perish or lose their minds to despair, she realizes the magical girl system is a cruel trap designed to harvest human suffering. To break the endless cycle of tragedy, she must sacrifice her own humanity and confront the horrifying truth behind the universe's creation.

When an ancient entity corrupts the pure hearts of magical girls, they are forced to hunt their former comrades in a brutal war of attrition. As the boundaries between savior and monster blur, one reluctant heroine must question whether the light she fights for is worth the psychological torment. To survive the ultimate descent into despair, she must sacrifice her humanity to defeat the darkness consuming her friends.

Deep within a fractured city where innocent wishes corrupt into despair, a solitary magical girl uncovers a horrifying truth about the cosmic war she was forced to fight. As her closest allies succumb to madness and turn against one another, she must choose between clinging to her fading ideals or embracing the cruel darkness necessary for survival. This psychological thriller strips away the glitter to expose the agonizing cost of salvation and the terrifying abyss waiting inside every miraculous transformation.

In a city where magical girls are revered as saviors, a young heroine discovers that the source of their mystical power is actually human suffering and sacrifice. As her closest friends begin to lose their memories and descend into madness, she must choose between upholding the cruel system or unleashing a catastrophe that could destroy the world. The boundary between hero and monster blurs as she fights a desperate psychological war against her own corrupted destiny.

In a city where magical girls are hailed as selfless saviors, young civilian girls are secretly conscripted into a brutal, unending war against grotesque manifestations of human trauma. As the casualty rate mounts and the line between monster and magical girl blurs, a newly awakened heroine begins to uncover the sinister psychological conditioning behind her sacred duty. To survive the harrowing combat, she must sacrifice her own memories and sanity, realizing too late that the greatest threat to her existence is the very system that chose her.
